title: Evaluation of an algebraic gate
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $x$ assign an element of $R$ to each of $n$ input variables, and let $v$ be a finite list of elements of $R$. An input-variable gate evaluates to its assigned value, the constant gate to $1$, and a gate combining nodes $j$ and $k$ evaluates their corresponding list entries using addition, subtraction, or multiplication, respectively; an out-of-range index contributes $0$.
hypotheses_covered: assignment of R-values to n input variables
